architecture: small CNN: conv5x5(3->16, pad 2) relu maxpool2, conv5x5(16->32, pad 2) relu maxpool2, conv3x3(32->64, pad 1) relu, global average pool, fc 64->64 relu, fc 64->10

input.layout: channel (0 red, 1 green, 2 blue), row (top to bottom), column (left to right)
input.dataset_facts: CIFAR-10 test set (Krizhevsky 2009): 10,000 colour photographs of 32 x 32 pixels, 1,000 per class, small natural images collected from the web (the 80 Million Tiny Images collection) and labelled by hand; one object of the class is the subject, usually near the centre, in front of varied backgrounds. "automobile" covers sedans, SUVs and similar cars, "truck" only big trucks; neither covers pickup trucks.

conv: cross-correlation as in PyTorch Conv2d: out[o, i, j] = bias[o] + sum_c sum_u sum_v weight[o, c, u, v] * in[c, i + u, j + v] (after zero padding)
global_average_pool: g[c] = the mean of the 64 values of channel c of the [64, 8, 8] map
output: 10 logits, class k = the k-th entry of classes; the prediction is the argmax (logits within 1e-9 x max(1, |max logit|) of the maximum count as tied; ties go to the lowest index)
metric: accuracy on the 10,000 CIFAR-10 test images
